lore.bio:
One day, Octavio Silva was bored. In fact, he was bored most days. Son of the preoccupied CEO of Silva Pharmaceuticals, he wanted for nothing in life and entertained himself by performing death-defying stunts and posting holovids for his fans to gawk over. On this day, he decided to set the course record for a nearby Gauntlet by launching himself across the finish line – using a grenade.
As he lay in triage hours later, the doctors informed him that the damage done to his legs meant his daredevil days were over. That didn’t sit well with Octavio, who turned to an old friend for help: Ajay Che, who he guilted into forging an order to replace his legs with bionic ones. Suddenly able to repair his limbs at a moment’s notice, Octavio decided petty online stunts weren’t enough: the ultimate adrenaline rush, the Apex Games, was calling.
Since then, Octane's world has gotten a little more complicated - his CEO father is now head of the Syndicate and, by extension, the Apex Games. Also, he may be plotting something pretty bad behind the scenes, and is maybe kind of not Octane's real dad? But that's just boring in a different, more uncomfortable way! Nothing matters more to Octane than becoming an Apex Champion by doing the most incredible, death-defying moves anyone's ever seen. In the ring, his problems can't catch him - he's too fast.

For more information on Octane's story, see Octane (character).

Incorporated Mad Hops and Aerial Agility into the base kit.
JumpPad now has two charges.
JumpPad has improved handling when double jumping.
JumpPads are useable immediately after hitting the ground.

Four new upgrades to replace all the base upgrades.
Thick Skin: Stim costs 10 less health to use.
Squad Rush: Everyone who uses your JumpPad gains Stim on land.
Daredevil: Gain fast reload on shield cracks and increase Stim Surge duration the less HP you have.
Triple Jump: Gain a third jump from JumpPads.

Upgrades
Wreckless: removed
Mad Hops moved to Level 2
Thick Skin: now Level 2 and 3, updated to take 5 less Stim damage to reflect that it can be selected twice (was -25%)
Upgrade - Wreckless: explosive damage is now reduced by 50% (was 25%)
Swift Mend: Reduced healing rate from 1.5 to 1.0 hp/sec.
Launch Pad: Reduced jump pad horizontal distance by 10% - 15%.
Launch Pad: Increased cooldown from 60s to 90s.

Stim:
Reduced cooldown between stims from 4s to 1s.
Increased health cost from 12hp to 20hp.

Launch Pad:
Increased bullet spread while in the air and shooting from the low launch pad trajectory.
Grenades will no longer get stuck and disappear when being bounced off of launch pads.
 Death Totems will no longer bounce when a Jump Pad is placed under it.
Players will no longer have weapons drawn if they are knocked as they enter the ring at Pathfinder's Fight Night via a Jump Pad.
Updated his Fidget Spinner  Skydive Emote to correctly remove his leg for which he is using it to do the helicoptering.
Fixed an issue with the Fidget Spinner  Skydive Emote preview not being present when inspected on  Xbox One.

Launch Pad:
Repeatedly using the same jump pad no longer disables double-jumps.
Players can no longer “glide” along a wall after using it.

Swift Mend:
Now disabled if silenced by Revenant.

Launch Pad:
Hitting the jump pad from a standing position will launch players along a high arc (the speed and trajectory of the old super-jump).
From a crouched position, players will launch along a low arc, meaning they'll fly lower but farther in the horizontal direction.
Launch Pad: Fixed an issue with it preventing players from jumping.

Swift Mend: Tripled healing rate (from 0.5 hp/s to 1.5 hp/s).
NOTE: The Patch Notes says doubled, but in actuality, it got tripled.
Fixed a visual issue that removed Revenant’s shadow form from a player after jumping off an Octane Jump Pad.
Fixed an issue with the Jump Pad clipping into the ground in certain areas.

Stim: No longer able to use it while healing.
Swift Mend: Fixed an issue with the regen being delayed after the use of  Stim.
Fixed issues with being pulled out of ADS, weapon firing stopping when  Stim ends/landing from a  Launch Pad.
Stim: Updated ability text.

Stim:
Now removes speed impairing effects when activated.
Sprinting speed is increased from 30% to 40%.
[Undocumented] Increased HP cost from 10 to 12.

Launch Pad:

Fixed an issue with the pads disappearing when other legend’s tactical interacts with it.
Fixed an issue with the pads falling through the floor on supply ships.
Launch Pad: Cooldown reduced from 90 seconds to 60 seconds.
Stim: Fixed an issue with FoV scaling messing up ADS aim sensitivity.
Launch Pad: Fixed bug where sometimes the launch pad would not launch the player.
Launch Pad: Fixed bug that caused throwable items to bounce off without actually touching the launch pad.
Launch Pad: Fixed audio bug.
Stim: Fixed issue where the trail would still linger after death.
Launch Pad: No longer affects players when using Wraith's  Into the Void ability.
